description: Nuestro equipo es formado por jóvenes apasionados por el espacio, en este hackaton esperamos desarrollar mejor las habilidades que ya tenemos y experimentar nuevas formas de investigación y prototipado. Con la experiencia de diferentes competencias creemos ser capaces de crear un proyecto a la altura del NASA SPACE APPS. Contamos con conocimientos en áreas como la electrónica, robótica, software y creación de algoritmos.
summary: HALO is an interactive interface that displays data as if viewed through the eyes of a doctor analyzing such information, thereby assisting in the reception, detection, and prevention of potential adverse events in space.
details:
HALO functions as a medical data visualization tool for astronauts in orbit. The project simulates health alerts—covering metrics such as body temperature, heart rate variability, oxygen saturation, heart rate, activity level, radiation exposure, and sleep status—and provides comprehensive mission reports, broken down by individual crew member, alongside a history of past missions.

Python and Arduino were used to facilitate communication between an ESP32 and an Arduino board and a web interface developed using HTML and JavaScript.

We firmly believe our project is both creative and innovative: it goes beyond simply issuing health alerts by also providing guidance to astronauts on how to respond to health-related changes—even when disconnected from Earth. This transforms what could otherwise be tedious, mechanical data into an interactive experience that is far more intuitive and visually clear. We have also carefully considered the sensitive nature of medical data, recognizing that maintaining good health is essential for every individual, even in space.
dataRefs: NASA SPACE FLIGHT MEDICAL SELECTION, RECERTIFICATION AND MISSION EVALUATION STANDARDS
